semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized automation and inspection equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Xiamen Fuqi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in automation solutions for the semiconductor industry. They focus on developing and manufacturing vision and optical inspection equipment, as well as automated dispensing and curing machines, addressing key production challenges in semiconductor fabrication.

regional_presence.China: The company operates a 3500㎡ facility in China, which includes a cleanroom and machining center, emphasizing R&D and production.
